name: Kimi no Iru Musou
source:
Setsu gets involved with a bad company at class. When he starts an argument with the only childhood friend, the worst personality traits come to surface.
Then a long-haired man appears and criticizes Setsu's point of view. And it helps to escape from reality.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
塞茨在班上与一群坏学生混在一起。当他和唯一的儿时玩伴争吵时，最糟糕的性格特征浮出水面。
随后，一个长发男人出现，批评塞茨的观点，并帮助他逃离现实。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
